description: A PERSONAL MESSAGE FROM VICTOR… This week I was reminded again why integrity is so rare in politics. Almost every week now, someone approaches me claiming they can “help me win.” The conversations usually sound similar promises of money, influence, or connections but they come with expectations. Sometimes it’s influence. Sometimes it’s access. Sometimes it’s positions of authority in a future administration. That’s how the system often works.
